author: reek
body: Imports three CSV lines and exports them straight back out, checking the result against the literal text that went in. Both halves convert between CCE and the ASCII the delimiter is written in, and a round trip is only an honest check because the expected lines here are the INPUT text: if either conversion is dropped the separator stops being a comma (CCE 44 is a letter, not a comma) and the integer fields read as zero, so the exported line cannot match what was imported.
